summary: Off-registry HTTPS tarball dependency pulls arbitrary bytes at install time
details: package.json declares its only dependency, `ltidisafe`, as a raw HTTPS tarball URL (`https://ltidi.storage.googleapis.com/depenconf/ltidisafe-4.0.8.tgz`) on a Google Cloud Storage bucket, with no version range, no integrity hash, and no pinned commit. `npm install` of @clikwraps/navigate will fetch and unpack whatever bytes that URL returns and execute any lifecycle scripts contained in the tarball on the installer's host. The shipped `index.js` is an empty stub, so the manifest line is the entire install-time effect of this package. The implausibly high version (99.9.1) combined with the lure-style scoped name is consistent with a dependency-confusion / resolution-hijack shape. Whoever controls the GCS bucket controls arbitrary code execution on any machine that installs this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
